title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.17753v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) on local devices keeps data private, removes per-token cost, cuts network latency, and keeps working without a connection. Two shifts now strain how such models are served. On one device, several agents share a locally served model with an interactive user. Across devices, a developer or small team often owns several capable machines from different vendors, which sit idle most of the day because every local server serves one runtime on one machine. We present Superfluid, an open-source LLM server built for local inference at both scales. On one device, Superfluid drives llama.cpp, MLX, or BaseRT in isolated worker processes through one scheduler that moves interactive requests ahead of agent work, computes a prompt shared by many requests once, and writes every token to a durable log before it reaches the client. Across devices, one Superfluid server turns a fleet of machines into a single API endpo

translated_title: Superfluid：面向分布式大语言模型推理的本地AI服务器
translated_abstract: 在本地设备上运行大语言模型（LLM）可以保护数据隐私、免除按token计费的成本、降低网络延迟，并在无网络连接时仍能正常工作。如今，两种变化正对这类模型的服务方式构成挑战。在单台设备上，多个智能体与交互式用户共享同一个本地服务的模型；在多台设备之间，开发者或小团队往往拥有来自不同厂商的多台性能不俗的机器，但由于每个本地服务器只能在一台机器上服务一个运行时，这些机器在一天中的大部分时间都处于闲置状态。我们提出了Superfluid，一个为上述两种规模的本地推理而构建的开源LLM服务器。在单台设备上，Superfluid通过统一的调度器驱动运行于隔离工作进程中的llama.cpp、MLX或BaseRT，将交互式请求排在智能体任务之前优先处理，对被多个请求共享的提示词只计算一次，并在每个token到达客户端之前将其写入持久化日志。在多台设备之间，一个Superfluid服务器可以将一组机器整合为单一的API端点……
tldr: Superfluid是一个开源本地LLM推理服务器，通过统一调度器在单设备上协调多智能体与交互用户共享模型服务（支持llama.cpp、MLX、BaseRT等运行时），并能将多台异构闲置机器聚合为单一API端点实现分布式推理。
en_tdlr: Superfluid is an open-source local LLM inference server that uses a unified scheduler to serve multiple agents and users sharing one model on a single device (backed by runtimes like llama.cpp, MLX, and BaseRT), and aggregates a fleet of heterogeneous idle machines into a single API endpoint for distributed inference.
